tagExport.title: Send tags to Rekordbox
tagExport.xmlDetail: Safest. Tags land in the Comments column. Your library is never modified.
tagExport.directDetail: Real, filterable MyTags. Takes a backup first; Rekordbox must be closed.
tagExport.warning: This writes directly into your Rekordbox library. <0>Close Rekordbox first.</0> SetRecord saves a timestamped backup of your database before writing, and rolls back if anything goes wrong.
tagExport.bullet1: Creates a “SetRecord” MyTag group with your tags
tagExport.bullet2: Tags only tracks that came from your Rekordbox library
tagExport.bullet3: Won’t duplicate tags a track already has
tagExport.xmlDoneDetail: Wrote {{count}} tracks to an XML file. In Rekordbox, use File → Import Collection (your library isn’t overwritten) — tags appear in the Comments column.
tagExport.nativeDoneDetail: Created {{tags}} MyTags and tagged {{tracks}} tracks. Open Rekordbox and filter by MyTag to see them.
